name: Lake County (NOPEC Group)
takeaway: NOPEC covers the majority of Lake County communities. June 2026 rate increase to 9.999¢ applies county-wide — blanket opportunity for any account still on the aggregation program.
hook: Most Lake County businesses are on NOPEC — that rate goes to nearly 10¢ next month. Worth a quick check on where your accounts stand.
notes: Umbrella zone covering Lake County NOPEC participants broadly. Includes communities like Mentor, Willoughby, Eastlake, Wickliffe, Willowick, Kirtland, and others. Verify individual community enrollment if needed.

name: Chardon / Geauga County
takeaway: Geauga County is largely NOPEC but has some rural township and municipal edges. Verify address-level enrollment before assuming NOPEC coverage.
hook: Chardon area is mostly NOPEC, but some Geauga County addresses fall outside the aggregation zone — do you know which program your locations are on?
notes: NOPEC coverage in Geauga County includes Chardon and many townships, but some rural corners and villages are not enrolled. Confirm address against NOPEC community list. June 2026 rate increase applies to enrolled addresses.
